cover.title: 3 things to know before you order

items.title: Order two days ahead
items.text: Fresh cakes take time; we plan every order the day before.

items.title: Tell us about allergies
items.text: Nuts are used in our kitchen every day; we tell you honestly.

items.title: Send a sketch or a photo
items.text: Your idea, our oven. A drawing on paper is enough.

cta.title: Ordering for a party?
cta.text: Comment the word and we'll send you the order form.
